notes: Sent by the Flutter plugin, not by the native SDK. An embedded flow view whose flow fails to load: ios/adapty_flutter/Sources/adapty_flutter/SwiftAdaptyPaywallNativeView.swift:129-141 (the view stays empty and the plugin reports the error with the view), the event as ios/adapty_flutter/Sources/adapty_flutter/SwiftAdaptyPaywallNativeView.swift:148-158 and an AdaptyUIError encoded as ios/adapty_flutter/Sources/adapty_flutter/SwiftAdaptyPaywallNativeView.swift:202-207 by ios@4.4.1 Sources.AdaptyPlugin/Codable/AdaptyUIError+Encodable.swift:13-24 (adapty_code, message as the debug description and detail as the description), the view as ios/adapty_flutter/Sources/adapty_flutter/SwiftAdaptyPaywallNativeView.swift:221-230 with the id of the platform view and the placement and variation of the flow in the creation params, ios/adapty_flutter/Sources/adapty_flutter/SwiftAdaptyPaywallNativeView.swift:232-241 (no locale: the flow was never built). Before activation the flow fails at ios@4.4.1 Sources.AdaptyUI/AdaptyUI+Public.swift:342-346 with AdaptyUIError.adaptyUINotActivated, 4003 at Sources.AdaptyUI/Error/AdaptyUIError.swift:36, with the texts of Sources.AdaptyUI/Error/AdaptyUIError+Description.swift:18-19,45-46. Below iOS 16 the plugin sends the same event with AdaptyUIError.platformNotSupported, 4001: ios/adapty_flutter/Sources/adapty_flutter/SwiftAdaptyPaywallNativeView.swift:80-90. ios@4.4.1 is the native the contract is fixed to; the native writes neither the event nor the view.
